// When the run started, for its time budget.
return [{ json: { started: Date.now() } }];

// One item per file to process (files_to_process picked the conversation's invoices and statements not processed yet).
return $input.first().json.content[0].text.files.map(file_id => ({ json: { file_id } }));

// Each invoice found in the file becomes its own item.
return $input.all().flatMap(item => item.json.content[0].text.files.map(file_id => ({ json: { file_id } })));

// The run's time is up: the invoice waits for the next run.
return $input.all().map(item => { const invoice_id = item.json.content[0].text.invoice_id; return { json: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: { status: 'wait', invoice_id, message: `Facture ${invoice_id} : la suite de son traitement reprendra a votre prochain message.` } }] } }; });

parameters.jsonInput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ session_id: $('Appel').first().json.session_id, answer: $('Appel').first().json.answer || $('Appel').first().json.client_message || '', decision: String($('Appel').first().json.decision ?? ''), about: String($('Appel').first().json.about ?? '') }) }}

parameters.output: ={{ $json.content[0].text.status !== 'ok' ? 0 : ({ check_duplicate: 1, settle_tva: 2, check_journal: 3, settle_withholding: 4, settle_prepaid: 5, settle_exercice: 6, configure_cabinet: 7, hold_posting: 8, post_invoice: 9, waiting_drafts: 10 }[$json.content[0].text.next_step] ?? 0) }}
